text: Not sure if I'm overreacting. I'm a childminder and one of mine, a baby girl, only 3 months old, has some little itchy spots coming up that look like chickenpox to me, her older brother had it last week. She's otherwise been herself. There's also a bit of pinky rash on her back but when I pressed a glass on it it went pale. Her temp is 38.2 though. Mum's on her way to collect, wanted to check what I should tell her.
